_note: Deterministic signal routing table. Maps signal envelope (type, severity, zone, ticker) to target agents + Telegram channel. First-match-wins evaluation. LLM/semantic routing is FORBIDDEN (CLAUDE.md §3). Catch-all always routes to po. Phase 0: read-only SSOT — nothing consumes this in Phase 0. Phase 3+ will use for adaptive dispatch.
_rule_evaluation: Array order, first match wins. Wildcard '*' matches any value on that axis. More-specific rules must appear before wildcards.

routing_policy.description: High-severity price alerts → alert-commander (position-danger or watchlist-opportunity gate)
Medium-severity price alerts → market-watcher for signal triage
Low-severity price alerts → market-watcher, status channel only
All macro alerts → unified-agent for narrative synthesis
All news signals → news-scout for sentiment and event triage
All BCTC (financial report) signals → po for sprint/task routing
All regime-change signals → unified-agent for market narrative update
Catch-all fallback — any unmatched signal envelope routes to po (per CLAUDE.md §3 and FR-P0-2 OQ-6: LLM router forbidden, deterministic table only)
